cards.front: Creo que deberías cortarte el pelo.
cards.back: I think you should have your hair cut.

cards.front: ¿Cuándo vas a encontrar tiempo para cortarte el pelo?
cards.back: When are you going to get around to having your hair cut?

cards.front: ¿Se dio ella cuenta de que te habías cortado el pelo?
cards.back: Did she notice that you'd had your hair cut?

cards.front: Hace sólo una semana me repararon el coche.
cards.back: I only had the car repaired last week.

cards.front: No tenemos suficiente dinero para que nos arreglen el coche este mes.
cards.back: We haven't got enough money to have the car repaired this month.

cards.front: Nos lo pueden arreglar cuando volvamos de las vacaciones.
cards.back: We can have it repaired when we get back from our holidays.

cards.front: Es hora de que nos pinten la casa de nuevo.
cards.back: It's time we had our house redecorated.

cards.front: Nos van a tener que pintar esta habitación; no aguanto el malva.
cards.back: We're going to have to have this room redecorated; I can't stand mauve.

cards.front: A Rachel le pintaron la casa el mes pasado; ha quedado genial.
cards.back: Rachel had her house redecorated last month; it looks great.

cards.front: Me acaban de enlosar el suelo del cuarto de baño.
cards.back: I've just had my bathroom floor tiled.

cards.front: No podemos permitirnos alicatar la cocina.
cards.back: We can't afford to have the kitchen tiled.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no te alicataron el cuarto de baño a la vez?
cards.back: Why didn't you have your bathroom tiled at the same time?

cards.front: No puedo permitirme arreglar el ordenador de nuevo.
cards.back: I can't afford to have my computer fixed again.

cards.front: ¿Conoces un sitio barato donde pueda reparar mi ordenador?
cards.back: Do you know a cheap place where I can have my computer fixed?

cards.front: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que tuviste que reparar tu ordenador?
cards.back: When did you last have to have your computer mended?

cards.front: Me cuesta seguir lo que él está diciendo.
cards.back: I'm having difficulty following what he's saying.

cards.front: No tuvimos ningún problema a la hora de entender a los empleados del hotel.
cards.back: We had no difficulty understanding the hotel staff.

cards.front: ¿Te costó entender lo que todos los demás decían?
cards.back: Did you have difficulty understanding what everyone else was saying?

cards.front: Puede que tengas problemas para encontrar el sitio sin un mapa.
cards.back: You might have trouble finding the place without a map.

cards.front: June tiene problemas para hablar sin sus dientes postizos.
cards.back: June has trouble talking without her false teeth.

cards.front: ¿Tiene alguno de los estudiantes problemas para seguir el ritmo?
cards.back: Are any of the students having trouble keeping up?

cards.front: ¿Todavía tienes problemas con los perros de tu vecino?
cards.back: Are you still having problems with your neighbour's dogs?

cards.front: Siempre tengo problemas para leer tu letra.
cards.back: I always have problems reading your handwriting.

cards.front: A veces ellos tienen problemas para comunicar sus ideas.
cards.back: They sometimes have problems getting their ideas across.

cards.front: Lo pasamos muy mal intentando cambiar el neumático bajo la lluvia torrencial.
cards.back: We had an awful time trying to change the tyre in the pouring rain.

cards.front: Lo estoy pasando muy mal con los mosquitos; me están comiendo literalmente vivo.
cards.back: I'm having an awful time with the mosquitos; they're literally eating me alive.

cards.front: Creo que lo pasaron muy mal en el aeropuerto; su avión se retrasó cinco horas y no había ningún sitio para dormir.
cards.back: I think they had an awful time at the airport; their plane was delayed five hours and there was nowhere to sleep.

cards.front: Jane está teniendo muchísimos problemas con los albañiles que contrató.
cards.back: Jane is having a nightmare with the builders she contracted.

cards.front: Tuve muchísimos problemas para encontrar a alguien que hablase inglés.
cards.back: I had a nightmare trying to find someone who spoke English.

cards.front: Estamos teniendo muchísimos problemas para encontrar un comprador para nuestro piso.
cards.back: We're having a nightmare finding a buyer for our flat.

cards.front: Haz que me llame enseguida.
cards.back: Have him call me right away.

cards.front: Haz que me llame a la oficina.
cards.back: Have him call me at the office.

cards.front: Haz que me llame antes de que él tome una decisión final.
cards.back: Have him call me before he makes a final decision.

cards.front: Haz que lo envíen urgente.
cards.back: Have it sent first class.

cards.front: Haz que lo envíen a nuestra oficina de Nueva York.
cards.back: Have it sent to our New York office.

cards.front: Haz que lo envíen de inmediato a todos nuestros clientes.
cards.back: Have it sent to all our clients immediately.

cards.front: Le hice llamarme a mi número privado.
cards.back: I had him call me on my private number.

cards.front: Le hice (a ella) llamarme en cuanto lo averiguó.
cards.back: I had her call me as soon as she found out.

cards.front: Les hice llamarme cuando se publicaron los resultados.
cards.back: I had them call me when the results were published.

cards.front: Hice que se enviara a tu domicilio particular.
cards.back: I had it sent to your home address.

cards.front: Hice que se enviara por mensajero.
cards.back: I had it sent by courier.

cards.front: Hice que se enviara antes de ayer.
cards.back: I had it sent the day before yesterday.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no haces que te lo envíen directamente a ti?
cards.back: Why don't you have it sent directly to you?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no haces que te lo envíen certificado?
cards.back: Why don't you have it sent by recorded delivery?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no haces que te llame?
cards.back: Why don't you have him call you?

cards.front: Una astilla en el dedo.
cards.back: A splinter in my finger.

cards.front: Una ampolla.
cards.back: A blister.

cards.front: Un esguince de tobillo.
cards.back: A sprained ankle.

cards.front: Espalda dolorida.
cards.back: A bad back.

cards.front: Dolor de garganta.
cards.back: A sore throat.

cards.front: Una pierna rota.
cards.back: A broken leg.

cards.front: Fiebre.
cards.back: A fever / a temperature.

cards.front: Un sarpullido.
cards.back: A rash.

cards.front: Un cardenal.
cards.back: A bruise.

cards.front: Un ojo morado.
cards.back: A black eye.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no intentas hacerlo?
cards.back: Why don't you have a go at doing it?

cards.front: Intentamos armar la tienda, pero al final tuvimos que dejárselo a los expertos.
cards.back: We had a go at putting up the tent, but in the end we had to leave it to the experts.

cards.front: Me encantaría probar el parapente.
cards.back: I would love to have a go at paragliding!

cards.front: Conversamos sobre los viejos tiempos.
cards.back: We had a nice chat about the good old days.

cards.front: Perkins, tenemos que hablar.
cards.back: Perkins, we need to have a chat.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no hablamos? Te sentirás mucho mejor después.
cards.back: Why don't we have a chat? You'll feel much better about it after that.

cards.front: ¿Puedo hablar contigo? Es bastante urgente.
cards.back: Can I have a word with you? It's rather urgent.

cards.front: Hablé con él sobre su desagradable olor corporal.
cards.back: I had a word with him about his body odour.

cards.front: Pero Recursos Humanos le iba a hablar sobre su desagradable olor corporal.
cards.back: But HR was going to have a word with him about his BO.

cards.front: Tuve unas palabras con él acerca de su comportamiento en la fiesta de lanzamiento.
cards.back: I had words with him about his behaviour at the launch party.

cards.front: Tuve unas palabras con ella acerca de su comportamiento en la fiesta.
cards.back: I had words with her about her behaviour at the party.

cards.front: Voy a tener que tener unas palabras con ellas.
cards.back: I'm going to have to have words with them.

cards.front: Ella se metió conmigo por llegar tarde.
cards.back: She had a go at me for being late.

cards.front: Me metí con ella por no decirme la hora correcta.
cards.back: I had a go at her for not telling me the right time.

cards.front: Mi jefa se metió con ellos por perder el tiempo.
cards.back: My boss had a go at them for wasting time.

cards.front: ¿Qué llevas puesto?
cards.back: What have you got on?

cards.front: Llevas el jersey puesto a revés.
cards.back: You've got your jumper on back to front / backwards.

cards.front: El hombre llevaba puesta una camisa azul y una corbata roja.
cards.back: The man had a blue shirt and a red tie on.

cards.front: ¡Él te está tomando el pelo!
cards.back: He's having you on!

cards.front: ¡Me estás tomando el pelo!
cards.back: You're having me on!

cards.front: ¡Ella siempre le está tomando el pelo a la gente!
cards.back: She's always having people on!

cards.front: ¿Por qué no invitamos a Jane a comer el sábado?
cards.back: Why don't we have Jane over for lunch on Saturday?

cards.front: Vinieron Mark y Andrea a cenar el domingo.
cards.back: We had Mark and Andrea over for dinner on Sunday.

cards.front: ¿Tuvisteis visita el fin de semana?
cards.back: Did you have anyone round at the weekend?

cards.front: Él la tiene tomada contigo.
cards.back: He's really got it in for you.

cards.front: Él la tiene tomada conmigo desde hace mucho tiempo.
cards.back: He's had it in for me for ages.

cards.front: No sé por qué él la tiene tomada contigo.
cards.back: I don't know why he's got it in for you.

cards.front: ¿Me devuelves mi bolígrafo, por favor?
cards.back: Can I have my pen back, please?

cards.front: ¿Me devuelves aquel CD que te presté, por favor?
cards.back: Can I have that CD I lent you back, please?

cards.front: ¿Me devuelves las llaves de mi coche, por favor?
cards.back: Can I have my car keys back, please?

cards.front: Se rumorea que el primer ministro va a dimitir.
cards.back: Rumour has it that the prime minister is going to resign.

cards.front: Corre el rumor de que los jefes van a comprar la empresa.
cards.back: Rumour has it that there's going to be a buy-out.

cards.front: Se rumorea que va a haber una escasez de gasolina, así que comprad provisiones mientras podáis.
cards.back: Rumour has it that there's going to be a petrol shortage, so buy in supplies while you can.

cards.front: Este televisor no da para más. Lo voy a tirar.
cards.back: This TV's had it. I'm going to chuck it out.

cards.front: Si vuelves a hacer eso, estás arreglado.
cards.back: If you do that again, you've had it.

cards.front: Si te pilla el jefe, ¡estás arreglada!
cards.back: If the boss catches you, you've had it!

cards.front: Estoy hasta las narices de ella. No para de hablar.
cards.back: I've had it up to here with her. She goes on and on and on and on.

cards.front: Estoy hasta las narices de mi banco. Me cobran constantemente por cosas que no he pedido.
cards.back: I've had it up to here with my bank. They're constantly charging me for things I didn't ask for.

cards.front: No van a estropear mi cumpleaños. ¡No lo pienso tolerar!
cards.back: They're not going to ruin my birthday. I won't have it!

cards.front: No pienso tolerar que ella me diga lo que tengo que hacer.
cards.back: I won't have her telling me what to do!

cards.front: No pienso consentir que ellos estropeen las cosas.
cards.back: I won't have them spoiling things!

cards.front: Os quedan cinco minutos.
cards.back: You have five minutes left.

cards.front: Sólo me queda un cartón de leche. Tendré que ir a comprar más.
cards.back: I only have one carton of milk left. I'll have to go and get some more.

cards.front: No nos queda mucha agua mineral. ¿Puedes ir a comprar más?
cards.back: We don't have much mineral water left. Can you go and get some more?
